name: accessibility-specialist
description: Accessibility standards and assistive features — remapping, text scaling, colorblind modes, screen reader support.

name: ai-programmer
description: Implements game AI — behavior trees, state machines, pathfinding, perception, decision-making, NPC and enemy behavior, AI debugging.

name: analytics-engineer
description: Telemetry and analytics — event tracking, player behavior, A/B test frameworks, dashboard specification, data pipelines.

name: art-director
description: Owns visual identity — style guides, art bible, asset standards, color palettes, UI visual direction.

name: asset-pipeline-manager
description: UOMD asset pipeline owner — naming, IDs, metadata, provenance, versioning, Gemini-generated asset staging and promotion.

name: audio-director
description: Owns sonic identity — music direction, sound palette, audio implementation strategy, mix balance.

name: community-manager
description: Player-facing communication — patch notes, social posts, community updates, feedback collection, player bug triage, crisis communication.

name: creative-director
description: Highest creative authority — vision, tone, aesthetic direction. Use when a decision affects game identity or department leads deadlock.

name: devops-engineer
description: Build pipelines, CI/CD configuration, version control workflow, branching strategy, automated test pipelines, deployment infrastructure.

name: economy-designer
description: Resource economies — loot tables, sink/faucet analysis, progression curve calibration, economic balance.

name: engine-programmer
description: Core engine systems — rendering pipeline, physics, memory, resource loading, scene management, performance-critical framework code.

name: game-designer
description: Mechanical and systems design — core loops, progression, combat, economy, player-facing rules. Mechanics-level questions.

name: gameplay-programmer
description: Implements designed mechanics as code — player systems, combat, interactive features, gameplay system code.

name: godot-csharp-specialist
description: Godot 4 C# quality — .NET patterns, attribute-based exports, signal delegates, async patterns, type-safe node access.

name: godot-gdextension-specialist
description: Native code integration with Godot — GDExtension API, godot-cpp and godot-rust bindings, custom node types, the native boundary.

name: godot-gdscript-specialist
description: GDScript code quality — static typing enforcement, signal architecture, coroutine patterns, GDScript idioms, typed and performant.

name: godot-shader-specialist
description: Godot rendering customization — shading language, visual shaders, material setup, particle shaders, post-processing.

name: godot-specialist
description: Godot 4.7.2 specialist — node/scene architecture, signals, resources, 2D mobile UI, portrait presentation, GDScript patterns, cloud/headless validation.

name: lead-programmer
description: Lead programmer — code-level architecture, coding standards, code review, API design, refactoring strategy, assigning work to specialist programmers.

name: level-designer
description: Spatial design for levels and areas — encounter layouts, pacing, difficulty, layout planning, environmental storytelling.

name: live-ops-designer
description: Post-launch content — seasonal events, battle passes, content cadence, retention, engagement analytics. Keeps the game fresh.

name: localization-lead
description: Internationalization architecture — i18n system design, string extraction workflows, locale testing, locale-specific issues, translation pipeline.

name: narrative-director
description: Story architecture, world-building, character design, dialogue strategy. Narrative structure and direction rather than writing individual lines.

name: network-programmer
description: Multiplayer networking — state replication, lag compensation, matchmaking, network protocol, netcode and bandwidth optimization.

name: performance-analyst
description: Performance analyst — profiling, bottlenecks, memory analysis, frame time investigation, recommends optimizations, tracks metrics over time.

name: producer
description: Production concerns — sprint planning, milestone tracking, risk, scope, cross-department coordination when multiple departments must synchronize.

name: prototyper
description: Throwaway builds — concept prototypes after brainstorm to test an idea is fun before GDDs; vertical slices pre-production. Speed over standards.

name: qa-lead
description: Test strategy and process — test plan creation, bug severity assessment, regression planning, release quality gates, readiness evaluation.

name: qa-tester
description: Writes test cases, bug reports, and checklists — test case generation, regression checklist creation, execution documentation.

name: release-manager
description: Release pipeline — certification checklists, store submissions and page prep, platform requirements, version numbering, release-day coordination.

name: security-engineer
description: Protects against cheating, exploits, breaches — anti-cheat measures, secure save data and network comms, player privacy compliance.

name: sound-designer
description: SFX specifications and spec sheets — audio event documentation, mixing parameters, sound category definitions.

name: systems-designer
description: Detailed subsystem mechanics — combat formulas, progression curves, crafting recipes, status effect interactions, mathematical modeling of a mechanic.

name: technical-artist
description: Technical artist bridging art and engineering — shaders, VFX, rendering optimization, art pipeline tools, art-to-engine issues.

name: technical-director
description: High-level technical decisions — engine architecture, technology choices, performance strategy, technical risk, cross-system conflicts.

name: tools-programmer
description: Internal dev tools — editor extensions, content authoring tools, debug utilities, pipeline automation, editor workflow.

name: ui-programmer
description: Implements user interface systems — menus, HUDs, inventory screens, dialogue boxes, UI framework code, screen flow.

name: ux-designer
description: User experience flows, interaction design, information architecture — user flow mapping, interaction pattern design, onboarding, accessibility requirements.

name: world-builder
description: World builder for lore — factions, cultures, history, geography, ecology, world rules. Faction design, lore consistency checks.

name: writer
description: Writer of player-facing text — dialogue, lore entries, item and ability descriptions, environmental text.
